en: The image shows a black and white photograph of a fenced grave with a tall gravestone or monument. The gravestone has inscriptions in what appears to be Danish. The grave is surrounded by a low metal fence and is set inside a small, lush cemetery with a stone wall in the background. Visible text in the bottom right corner identifies the grave as belonging to a general and mentions a place called 'Dybbøl Kirkegaard.'
